process.title: How do you arrange a cremation online?
process.lede: It is simple, clear, and careful.
process.pageLede: Six steps, in this order. Today we coordinate documents and payment with you by phone or WhatsApp.

steps.title: Choose your service
steps.text: Pick Basic, Signature, or VIP. If you are unsure, write to us and we will help you compare.

steps.title: Share your details
steps.text: Leave your name, email, and phone, and tell us what you need. We reply during opening hours.

steps.title: Send the documents
steps.text: We tell you which records we need and how to send them. The site does not have a file upload yet.

steps.title: Pay through a secure channel
steps.text: We confirm the plan amount and how to pay. The site does not charge online yet.

steps.title: We coordinate the rest
steps.text: We arrange the associated crematorium, the date, and the individual cremation. We tell you before each step.

steps.title: Receive the ashes at home
steps.text: We deliver the ashes to the address you give us, as part of the plan you chose.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lede: Direct answers about the service. If yours is missing, write to us.
faq.empty: Questions will be available in a moment.

items.a: All three plans include document coordination, an associated crematorium, an individual cremation, and home delivery of the ashes. Signature and VIP add a different urn, a different presentation, and closer coordination. The detail is on each plan.
Yes. Every plan includes an individual cremation.

Coordination starts when we receive the documents. The date is agreed with the associated crematorium and confirmed with you before we continue. We do not publish a fixed number of days, because it depends on the paperwork and the crematorium’s schedule.
An authorized associated crematorium in Santiago, Metropolitan Region. We tell you which one when you arrange the service.

items.q: Can I arrange this from home?
items.a: Yes. Use the form, call, or send a WhatsApp. The rest of the coordination is also done at a distance.

items.q: Are the ashes delivered to my home?
items.a: Yes. All three plans include home delivery of the ashes. The VIP plan adds special coordination for that delivery.
No. The amounts on the site are a reference. The price is confirmed when you arrange the service, based on the plan you choose.

crematoriums.title: Associated crematoriums
crematoriums.lede: The cremation takes place at an authorized crematorium in Santiago, Metropolitan Region. Eternova coordinates the date and the information that needs to travel with it.
crematoriums.alt: A contemporary crematorium building, with a glass front and a garden.
crematoriums.body: We do not publish a street address until the crematorium for your service is confirmed. When you arrange it, we tell you the place, the date, and what to prepare.
crematoriums.point2: The date is confirmed with you before the cremation.
crematoriums.point3: The ashes return to your home according to the plan.

about.title: About Eternova
about.lede: We coordinate the cremation so you can arrange it from home, with an associated crematorium in Santiago.
about.p1: Eternova takes the coordination: documents, contact with the crematorium, the individual cremation, and delivery of the ashes to your home.
about.p2: You choose the plan. We tell you what is missing, the date, and how the ashes come back. Payment and documents are arranged with you by phone or WhatsApp.
about.p3: We answer Monday to Sunday, 8:00 to 20:00, by phone, WhatsApp, and the contact form.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lede: The form asks only for what we need to reply.
privacy.p1: Name, email, phone, the plan if you already chose one, and the message you write. If a hidden company field comes back filled in, we discard the submission. It filters automated sends.
privacy.p2: To answer your question and follow the request. If notification email is configured, the team also receives a copy.
privacy.p3: We keep the message while we are following your request. You can ask us to delete it through the same phone numbers or the form.
privacy.p4: You can ask for access, correction, or deletion. In Chile, the reference framework is Law 19.628 on the protection of private life. This text does not replace legal advice.
privacy.p5: We store only your cookie answer in this browser, so we do not ask again on every visit. We do not use advertising or measurement cookies. If you accept, that permission is recorded. If you choose only what is necessary, nothing else is turned on. You can change the decision whenever you want.

cookies.label: Cookies
